body: Faithful port of internal/posture/machine.go's pure decision logic (6 states, real transition table, GAME toggle, all 13 real capabilities + their per-posture overrides) into a Ravenscar-profile protected object. Honest status: UNVERIFIED, no GNAT toolchain existed in this monorepo before this session and this sandbox has no passwordless sudo -- queued as sudo-queue/17-install-gnat.sh. A complete selftest (posture_selftest.adb) is ready to run the moment the toolchain exists. Commit EmilyOS 4bb7a85.
title: Ravenscar Ada port of the posture state machine (module, unverified)
